mapper.update: UPDATE job_execution SET runtime_engine=#{engine}, artifact_sha256=#{sha}, environment_revision=#{revision}, interpreter_version=#{version}, execution_mode=#{mode} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE job_execution SET script_options_revision=#{revision} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE job_execution SET request_id = #{requestId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job_execution SET status=#{systemExitStatus}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), message='Host restarted while job was running' WHERE status=#{runningStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_execution WHERE finished_at < #{cutoff} AND status <> #{runningStatus}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM job_execution WHERE finished_at < #{cutoff} AND status <> #{runningStatus} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_execution WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status=#{runningStatus}
SELECT e.* FROM job_execution e e.id=#{id}
SELECT e.* FROM job_execution e WHERE e.id=#{id}
SELECT e.* FROM job_execution e ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
